{{Top|leg}}
The '''AH-50''' was a type of [[Power cell/Legends|power cell]] developed and manufactured by [[PowaTek]]. They were used in the [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-ST]] [[Walker/Legends|walker]], used in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].
